prompt:
note combine the requested prefix using bitwise XOR
fn fold_value items view ulong 12 count ulong to ulong
reference:
s = ulong 0
for i ulong count
s = xor s get items i
end
ret s
end
main:
fn main to int
buf = new ulong 12 0
put buf 0 3
put buf 1 5
put buf 2 0
put buf 3 5
if ne fold_value buf ulong 4 ulong 3
ret 83
end
ret 77
end
